dimensions.description: Fits workflow-core, agent-ecosystem, tooling, knowledge, or runtime-policy.
Recent commits, releases, issue or PR activity, and maintainer continuity.
Tests, CI, docs, examples, versioning, and stable interfaces.
License, security policy, dependency posture, Scorecard, and safe install surface.
Provides a mechanism not already covered by ADK assets.
Low dependency load and easy conversion into gates, fixtures, runbooks, templates, or tests.

hard_reject_rules.description: No meaningful maintenance activity for 12 months.
Install instructions require unreviewed remote execution, privileged system writes, or long-lived tokens.
Candidate duplicates an existing ADK capability without a concrete advantage.
Source cannot become a verifiable gate, fixture, runbook, template, or test.
Candidate requires credentials, private services, or hosted infrastructure that cannot be reviewed locally.
